events.verdict: Moore (NOP) is not in a legal guarding position when he engages Winslow (MIA) with two arms in the post and affects his FOM.
Moore (NOP) makes incidental contact with Winslow's (MIA) arm during the follow-through on his shot attempt near the rim.
Adebayo (MIA) and Moore (NOP) make incidental leg contact during rebounding.
Holiday (NOP) commits a take foul on Richardson (MIA).
Davis (NOP) sets the pick in Richardson's (MIA) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Olynyk (MIA) jumps from point A to point B and makes more than marginal contact with Holiday (NOP) following his shot attempt near the rim.
Davis (NOP) sets the screen in Richardson's (MIA) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Adebayo (MIA) sets the pick in Randle's (NOP) path and does not prevent him from disengaging from the contact.
Randle (NOP) makes marginal contact with Richardson's (MIA) body that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] Holiday (NOP) moves his pivot foot heel to toe.
Richardson (MIA) briefly grasps Randle (MIA) but does not affect his FOM.
Wade (MIA) briefly grasps Frazier (NOP) but does not affect his FOM.
Winslow (MIA) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Holiday (NOP) that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
McGruder (MIA) holds Mirotic (NOP) and affects his ability to get to the rebound.
Randle (NOP) commits a take foul on Winslow (MIA).
